free_resources.title: Meditation before Sleep
free_resources.description: A short guide to Christian meditation at the end of the day: preparing a quiet space, an evening prayer drawing on Julian of Norwich, then settling the breath with a simple prayer word and letting the day's thoughts pass while resting in God's presence.

flags: The guide is framed around winding down for sleep with prayer; no health claim of any kind, so it passes the 12 Nov rule.
This brings the listing to 5 free resources (the cap; plan count, live not re-counted).
